purpose: Persistent decision-layer watchlist owned by ChatGPT. A coin stays here until actionable or structurally invalidated; it must not disappear because of one weaker 5-minute scan.

operating_rules.manual_capture_fallback_only: Ask the user for a Bitvavo Pro screenshot only if the autonomous public execution probe is unavailable/stale or if a UI-only/private-account fact is genuinely required.
operating_rules.private_account_boundary: Public execution validation does not require account access. Wallet balance, user's open orders, personal fills and private trade history require authenticated Bitvavo API access and must never be committed to this public repository.
operating_rules.winner_retention_rule: Do not discard a strong 7d/30d trend solely because the immediate Entry Score weakens. Track pullback/re-entry candidates until structural invalidation.
operating_rules.latent_accelerator_rule: Coins detected with Opportunity Score >= 7.4 but not promoted because Entry/Trend is weak must remain under observation when acceleration evidence exists; CFG/ORCA/IOST are audit examples.
